title: A Mother's Loathing
summary: Drink as a Bonus Action to gain Bite until the next Long Rest.

fields.Bite: Action. Melee unarmed attack, once per turn, for 2d4 Piercing. Cannot target Undead, Plants, Elementals, Oozes, Constructs, or Petrified creatures.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 mechanics and pinned item and related rule sources.
